ana: Heads-up — after the IdP cert rotate a subset of users see SAML login failures, backend reports assertion decrypt errors.

mike: Seen too, reproducible on 3 hosts. Log excerpt: `saml: decrypt failed: crypto/aesgcm: invalid tag`

samir: Did we rewrap with KMS during the rotate? which alias?

ana: alias/redwood/idp-encrypt rotated ~1748199000. KMS logs show rewrap ok but our provisioner returns 403 on decrypt for some records.

security-bot: Alert created: SAML_DECRYPT_FAIL (inc-1748200000) :rotating_light:

jess: Quick checklist: (1) clock skew, (2) metadata/entityID mismatch, (3) proxy truncation of POST body.

mike: Clock looks fine. Grabbed metadata: `curl -sS https://idp.prod.example.com/metadata` — cert chain valid.

ana: App log (redacted): ```
error: saml: decrypt: crypto/aesgcm: ciphertext too short
stack: auth/saml/handler.go:142
```

samir: "ciphertext too short" suggests truncation before decrypt. Could be proxy, load-balancer, or a streaming rewrap bug.

jess: Any big SCIM backfills or async jobs that might hit KMS quotas and produce partial writes?

ana: There was a SCIM batch yesterday (completed). We do have an async provisioning queue with recent retries (~1700).

mike: Repro steps: (A) capture raw SAMLResponse from browser (B) run KMS `Decrypt` on the ciphertext we've captured to check if KMS accepts it.

ana: I pasted the captured response into `saml-response.txt` in the ticket — it truncates at ~480 bytes where the signature block should continue.

samir: Try forcing the service to use prior key version (alias:redwood/idp-encrypt:v1) — if v1 decrypts then rotation wiring is inconsistent across hosts.

ana: Can we fallback to prior key quickly? rotation was intended to be seamless but alias may not be consistently updated in some regions.

jess: For mitigation: enable fallback to v1 for 1 hour, and throttle the SCIM batch if we see correlated failures. Opened GH issue redwood/sso-proxy#452 and added a 10% canary change: `NGINX_PROXY_REQUEST_BUFFERING on`.

oncall: Running `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://saml.enc --key-id alias/redwood/idp-encrypt` against the captured blob now. Will post result.

oncall (1m later): `InvalidCiphertextException` — same error as prod. KMS won't decrypt this blob.

mike: KMS succeeds on known-good test payloads, fails on the captured ciphertext -> corruption before it hits KMS.

ana: Hypothesis: frontend proxy (sso-proxy/NLB) is reassembling chunked requests incorrectly when `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` present, dropping final chunk.

samir: Good call. Add short-term detection: checksum header (Content-MD5) for SAML POSTs and log mismatches. Also fail-fast when length/signature missing.

jess: Deploy plan: add checksum + increased request buffering on the proxy. Canary at 10%, monitor `SAML_DECRYPT_FAIL` and `kms::InvalidCiphertextException` metrics.

mike: Also add an audit event for each failure containing `idp_entity`, `assertion_length`, and `decrypt_ok=false` so we can slice by user/region.

security-bot: Incident update: severity -> monitoring; flagged for postmortem.

ana: Thanks — I'll coordinate infra rollout and gather more raw captures. Will update thread with repro links and timeline.
